note: Draft-order eligibility rules confirmed by the commissioner on 2026-10-20, plus the top-of-draft history they are computed from. Eligibility is derived by scripts/lottery_eligibility.py. This file does NOT define the lottery odds or how an ineligible team's lottery result is redrawn: the league has not yet decided how it implements the NBA's 2027 lottery reform (see docs/GOVERNANCE_ROADMAP.md).

noTop2TwiceInARow.text: A team that picked 1st or 2nd in a draft cannot pick 1st or 2nd in the next draft.

oneNumberOnePerWindow.text: A team may make only one number-one pick in any 3-year span of drafts.

rules.source: Commissioner confirmation relayed by the league owner, 2026-10-20.

openQuestions: Whether eligibility follows the team that holds and uses the pick or the team whose record earned it, if a top-2 pick is traded. Both are the same team in every draft recorded so far.
How an ineligible team's lottery result is handled (redraw, next slot, ...): not decided.

history.source: League owner, 2026-10-20: 'I picked 1st last year'; owner's team is Yahoo team 16 = sup fam. The 2025 second pick is not recorded here (not needed for any current eligibility).
